notes: Definitions and unreadable values: (1) Page 4 dashboard overview uses a relative benchmark scale without printed numeric values. (2) Page 8 incidence and mortality rates for Finland (654 and 243 per 100,000) are crude rates for all sites excluding non-melanoma skin cancer (text and Appendix p. 31 state 2023; chart source note mentions 2022 data for ECIS EU27). (3) Page 9 survival rates are 5-year age-standardized relative survival rates from NORDCAN. (4) Page 15 stacked bar chart (Stage distribution 2019-2023) prints data labels only for Unknown stage (All cancers 61%, Breast 35%, Lung 54%, Colon & rectum 53%, Bladder & urinary tract 43%, Skin melanoma 87%); Localized and Non-localized bar segments have no printed labels and could not be read reliably without estimation. (5) Page 16 bar chart (Breast screening participation rate by wellbeing services county in 2023) shows bars for Whole country, 21 wellbeing services counties, City of Helsinki, and Åland without printed data labels and with y-axis gridlines only at 20% intervals (plus an 80% target line); only the exact values printed in text/summary chart were extracted (Whole country 82%, City of Helsinki 72%, Åland 86%), while individual county bars near 80% could not be read accurately. (6) Page 18 reported ranges (600-700 patients exceeding 180-day limit; <2% share; 36-38 days median time from diagnosis to treatment in lung cancer; 2-4 weeks GP to specialist waiting time; comparator 2-7 days and 1-2 weeks) are split into min/max upper/lower bounds without averaging. (7) Page 20 primary care CT availability in Finland is reported as <10% (upper bound 10% extracted). (8) Page 21 biomarker testing availability tables use qualitative categories (Always, Usually, Occasionally, Research, Never) rather than numeric values. (9) Page 23 aNSCLC drug treatment chart prints total percentages (44%-49%) for 2014-2020; modality breakdown segments are unlabeled except 2020 values given in text (34% chemo, 6% immuno, 8% targeted) and ESMO benchmark (25% chemo, 39% immuno, 11% targeted).
